rules.functions: 0 failed checks → A, 1 → B, 2 → C, 3 or more → D
rules.verdict: inside the AI band → quoted price stands; exactly one grade below → revised offer; two or more below → mismatch (mismatch_fee)

cases.description: Failed-check mapping: 1 → B, 2 → C, 3 → D, 5 → D
Worst component wins: cosmetic C beats battery A and functions B
Verdict inside: final B within band [A,B]
Verdict one_below: final C against band [A,B] produces a revised offer
Verdict two_below: final D against band [A,B] is a mismatch with the ₹100 mismatch fee
Verdict one_below for a three-wide Low band: final D against [A,B,C]
A grade better than the band keeps the quoted price
cases.notes: Docs define inside / one_below / two_below only. Assumed: better than the band counts as inside (quoted price stands).

cases.description: Revised offer at the confirmed grade (market ₹50,000 A, confirmed C → ₹41,000 market)
Battery health outside 50–100 is rejected as invalid input
